channel.title: LangChain Blog
channel.description: Thought leadership, news, tutorials, and case studies on agent engineering.

item.title: What Is Eval-Driven Development? How to Improve AI Agents
item.description: Eval-driven development helps you build AI agents against a consistent set of metrics. Define good behavior, write the eval first, then compare experiments.

item.title: Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
item.description: Managed Deep Agents v0.10 adds browser use, so agents can work on sites with no API and hand you the window to sign in, and async subagents for background work.

item.title: Agents Are Going Async
item.description: Async subagents let an agent stay responsive while background workers run long tasks. How the orchestrator, notifications and approvals work in Deep Agents.

item.title: How We Optimized Browser Use for Deep Agents
item.description: We compared seven browser toolsets for Deep Agents, picked Stagehand from Browserbase, and tuned it with LangSmith traces and evals. Here's what we learned.

item.title: Browser Use in Managed Deep Agents
item.description: Managed Deep Agents now runs a browser for your agent, with tools tuned for context-efficient browser use and a handoff so you can sign in yourself.

item.title: Context Engineering (Agent Memory) for AI Agents Starts with Retrieval
item.description: Agents waste time and context on clumsy searches, oversized results and stale data. Learn the retrieval techniques LangChain's Deep Agents harness uses to get the right context in.

item.title: LangSmith BYOC is now available on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
item.description: LangSmith BYOC now runs on AWS (GA), Azure and Google Cloud (Beta). Your traces, evals, and agent deployments stay in your cloud account while LangChain runs it.

item.title: Why human insight is a strategic advantage for building better agents
item.description: Explore 3 principles for effective human-in-the-loop workflows and how human-review is a strategic imperative for production-ready agents.

item.title: Managed Deep Agents: the fastest way to ship a production deep agent
item.description: Run deep agents in production with durable execution, sandboxes, tool access, and LangSmith observability, without building the runtime yourself. Now in private beta

item.title: New context engineering challenges in late 2026
item.description: LangChain CEO Harrison Chase shares insights into the biggest harness engineering challenges with the emergence of proactive agents.

item.title: How We Built Our Design Agent
item.description: How LangChain built Content Studio, an open-source design agent in Slack that makes on-brand videos, graphics and decks, and the harness that powers it.

item.title: How We Built LangChain’s Paid Media Agent
item.description: How LangChain built a paid media agent to analyze campaign performance, optimize ads, propose changes, and turn marketing data into action.

item.title: The Art of Loop Engineering
item.description: Agents automate real-world work, but reliable performance requires more than a good model, it requires a carefully designed harness built for specific tasks. This post explores the core agent loop, how stacking and extending loops builds more effective agents, and how to instrument each level with LangChain primitives.

item.title: Context Engineering with Deep Agents: How To Remember Without Keeping Everything In Context
item.description: Long-running agents degrade as context piles up. Learn how offloading, summarization, skills, subagents, and memory keep your agent's context window focused.

item.title: How to Build Proactive, Always-On Agents with the Schedules SDK in Managed Deep Agents
item.description: Most proactive agents run on a simple cron. Learn what scheduled runs unlock, from memory to smart triage, and how to add them to Managed Deep Agents.

item.title: How to build evidence-grounded agent memory with OpenWiki and Graphs
item.description: LangChain used OpenWiki, its open-source wiki compiler, and an evidence graph to build a persistent memory layer that preserves knowledge for agents to reuse across tasks. Learn how.

item.title: The five components of building a "company harness"
item.description: Learn how LangChain built internal agents across marketing, sales, and engineering, and how they have completely changed how those teams work.

item.title: LangSmith LLM Gateway: Runtime Controls for Agents
item.description: LangSmith LLM Gateway is in public beta: spend caps, rate limits, model fallbacks and PII redaction for production agents, without provider lock-in.

item.title: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
item.description: How Numan built Nu, an AI health coach, on LangGraph and LangSmith with per-category evals, simulated conversations, and safety gates on a regulatory line.

item.title: October 2026 LangChain Newsletter: Everything we shipped at Interrupt NYC & London
item.description: What we shipped at Interrupt NYC and London: LangSmith AI Search, Engine v2, Trajectories, Custom Apps, Fine-Tuning, and Managed Deep Agents v0.9.
